title: Store Leadership/Store Team Responsibilities
text:
Store Leadership/Store Team 
Responsibilities
Provide the following designated spaces:
• 8ft of fresh processing area in the prep room or cut room with shelving above the prep table
• 8ft Cooler space with pallet position and shelving in cooler for storage of fresh fruit & vegetables case 
goods to be stored
• Space for processed fruit/veg bins and a Fruit Cart/Speed Rack for packaged product within the 8ft 
area in the Cooler
• Pallet space for dry goods, space for storage of labels, containers and smallware's.
• Prep-Table (8ft table with a tabletop wrapper or 6ft table with stand-wrapper), 3-compartment sink, 
Prep-sink with Produce Maxx wash, wrap station, shrink wrap, plastic gloves, trash bags, paper towels, 
& Ecolab cleaners are supplied by Kroger
• All the above areas should be properly labeled for Franchisee with Best Practice signage
• In line cut fruit/veg space minimum of 4, 6 or 12ft based on previous Fresh Kitchen space
• Combo sets need approval by Kroger GO and 3rd Party Parent Company
• Sections should be free of Kompass strips, shelf tags and be cleaned upon transition to the In-Store Cut 
program
• Any remaining Fresh Kitchen fruit on launch day should be scanned out as outdated and composted
• Provide permanent use of one (1) Mobile M1 Case for merchandising of $5 Bowls

title: Franchisee Responsibilities
text:
Franchisee Responsibilities
Franchisee will have access to the following:
• Designated cooler space for storage of fresh fruit, vegetables case goods, dry goods storage space for storage of 
labels, containers and small wares
• Prep-Table (8ft table with a tabletop wrapper or 6ft table with stand-wrapper) 3 compartment sink, wrap station, 
shrink wrap, gloves, trash bags, paper towels, & Ecolab cleaners and produce MAXX wash
• Franchisee will use designated fresh fruit processing space in the produce prep room or cut fruit room to process 
and package fruit & vegetables daily
• Franchisee will execute all aspects of cutting, packaging & labeling of product. Product labels will include 
description and UPC. Apply price point stickers on all items that qualify
• Fresh fruit, vegetables and supply needs, will be communicated to the Produce Manager using the provided 
Kroger/Franchisee in store order guide & retail purchase guide
• Franchisee is responsible for all POGs; the POGs are Kroger GO mandated and should not be adjusted without GO 
approval
• Outdated product will be removed from sales floor by the Franchisee daily by 9am — Product with today's date 
(Perception Dating) will be removed from the sales floor by 9am
• If outdated product is not removed from store, the Franchisee will use the store compost system
• Franchisee is responsible for all Food Safety Logs, Temp Logs
11 ©2026 GBC Food Services LLC - Company and Affiliates Confidential 11

Franchisee Responsibilities
Franchisee Responsibilities
• Franchisee will provide the completed Order Guide to Produce Leadership in a timely manner for ordering 
purposes
• Franchisee will purchase all Fruit, Veg & Supplies day of delivery prior to processing
• Franchisee will provide a duplicate receipt, upon purchasing Fruit, Veg & Supplies, to Produce Leadership.
• Product may not be processed or used prior to purchasing and supplying a receipt to the Produce 
Leadership team
• Franchisee should not take product from loads that have not been processed by the Produce Team
• If an item is shorted or scratched from the DC, Kroger will retain priority with what product is received and 
the product may not be able to be sold to the Franchisee for the Cut Fruit program
• Franchisee will maintain, in a binder, receipts/order guides of all product & supplies ordered and 
purchased in the Produce Department (8 weeks of documentation)

• Franchisee will utilize Pay Scan Sheet to purchase all Vegetables by case and or individually

title: Produce Department Responsibilities
text:
Produce Department 
Responsibilities
• Produce Leader will order the requested fresh fruit and 
packaging case quantities that are provided by the 
Franchisee in accordance with the stores Fresh Produce

system

the Cut Fruit/Veg program

title: Guac Ready Avo Procedures
text:

Guac Ready Avocado Procedures
• 3rd Party In-Store Cut Fruit stores will 
receive Guacamole ready avocados. 
These avocados are for 3rd party use 
ONLY. These avocados will be stage 4-5 
ripeness upon arrival.
• The avocados will be in a specific box 
with stickers indicating "Guac Ready“

weekly. Each store will receive 2 cases 
per week. 1 case early week 1 case late 
week
• Franchisees will use the Guac Ready UPC on 
the Payable Scan-Sheet to purchase the Guac 
Ready avocados cases.
• If Franchisees need additional avocados the 
Produce Manager can order regular case 
avocados for the Franchisee to purchase.
